title: Postgres primary failover drill — eu-west
message: We will fail over the primary Postgres node in eu-west to its replica. Brief read-only mode (~90s) is expected on Public API and Internal dashboard.

title: Kafka cluster upgrade — ingest fleet
message: Rolling upgrade of the Kafka cluster powering Telemetry ingest. Some lag is expected on streaming consumers; producers will continue uninterrupted.

title: Search index re-shard
message: Quarterly re-shard of the search index for the increased corpus size.

title: Webhook fanout autoscaler upgrade
message: Upgrade the webhook fanout autoscaler from v2 to v3. No customer-visible impact expected.
